items.name: Grit
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Getting burst in lane. Sell it for Mystic Reverb.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-8,000 (levels 1-14). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Itani Lo Sahn unlocked. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Improved Spirit. Ultimate (Itani Lo Sahn) is available from Spirit Lifesteal.

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 15.5 to Flawless Advance's perfect damage (1.55x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling.

items.name: Mystic Burst
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Improved Spirit completes 3,200 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Improved Spirit completes 4.8k spirit in 3200 souls (~3.2 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.caption: Imbued on Flawless Advance: widens its radius and range (attack dash range, dash range, slash length).
items.why: imminent: Improved Spirit completes 4.8k spirit in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Imbued on Flawless Advance: takes 18% off its 14s base cooldown.

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (4,000 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power. +18 spirit adds about 27.9 to Flawless Advance's perfect damage (1.55x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Spirit Lifesteal
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Enchanter's Emblem, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Regen
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Enchanter's Emblem completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Enchanter's Emblem completes 4.8k vitality in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Healing Booster
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Enchanter's Emblem completes 1,600 souls on. Upgrade of Extra Regen (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Enchanter's Emblem completes 4.8k vitality in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 8,000-24,000 (levels 14-27). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Disengaging Sigil T3, Flawless Advance T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Flawless Advance, perfect damage) grows from 184 to 315. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Enchanter's Emblem.

items.name: Enchanter's Emblem
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus.

items.name: Tankbuster
items.caption: Flawless Advance (269) clears its 165-damage trigger. Takes spirit from 4,800 to 7,200 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power. Upgrade of Mystic Burst (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Mystic Vulnerability
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 7,200 to 8,800 invested: bonus 45 to 52 spirit power.

items.name: Greater Expansion
items.caption: +30% range and radius on everything that scales with them: Itani Lo Sahn dash range (35m), Riposte dash range (35m), Flawless Advance slash length (13m). Takes spirit from 8,800 to 11,200 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power. Upgrade of Mystic Expansion (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Extra Stamina
items.caption: Builds toward the 6.4k vitality tier, which Stamina Mastery completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Stamina Mastery completes 6.4k vitality in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Stamina Mastery
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 5,600 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 46 vitality bonus.

items.name: Torment Pulse
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: swap_candidate)

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 14,400 to 16,000 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power. | With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 150s; 20% off is 30s per full rotation.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 24,000-51,200 (levels 27-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Riposte T3, Itani Lo Sahn T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Flawless Advance, perfect damage) grows from 315 to 453.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 78 to Itani Lo Sahn's delayed damage (2.60x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Upgrade of Improved Spirit (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Leech
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 8,000 to 12,800 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 20,800 to 27,200 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power.

items.name: Mystic Reverb
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 27,200 to 33,600 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: upgrade_of)

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Tankbuster? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Torment Pulse.
sections.desc: Dying after Tankbuster? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Torment Pulse.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Hexes and slows stop you lunging in or getting out.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Grey Talon's charged arrow.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun carry is melting you.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: A stun cancels your Disengaging Sigil (movement) and Riposte (channelled). Activate this before the stun lands (it cannot be used while stunned): 5.5s immune to stun, silence, sleep, root and disarm, 60s cooldown.
items.legacy_note: Stuns and silences keep stopping you.

items.name: Healbane
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Their healer keeps your target alive.

items.name: Witchmail
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 12,800 to 17,600 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Echo Shard
items.caption: Imbued on Flawless Advance: resets its 14s cooldown for a second cast; the shard's own 30s cooldown grows by that ability's cooldown. Replaces Tankbuster: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).
items.legacy_note: On Flawless Advance. Sell Tankbuster for this.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
